title: Companionship in the Age of Social Media
summary: Al-sahib saahib (a companion influences). Today’s influencers are virtual companions. Do not attack his friends; instead, strengthen his standards: who uplifts you and who drags you down? Discuss with him whom he follows and why, and teach him that a role model is chosen with awareness.
try_this: This week: Ask your teenager whom he follows and admires, and discuss together the qualities of a righteous role model.
reflection_prompts: Who influences your teenager the most?
Does he distinguish the beneficial role model?
